items.title: Citi boosts headcount, Invesco names new executive in Asia expansion
items.summary: US financial firms Citigroup and Invesco are expanding their presence in Asia despite geopolitical uncertainties. Citi is boosting its North Asia and Japan corporate banking desk headcount by 25% and expanding its China desk network. Invesco has appointed a new Asia-Pacific head, demonstrating continued investment in the region.

items.title: Eastman Chemical (EMN) Q1 2025 Earnings: Results, Market Reaction & History
items.summary: Eastman Chemical (EMN) reported Q1 2025 earnings with adjusted EPS of $1.91, beating estimates, while revenue of $2.29 billion missed expectations. The company saw improved adjusted EBIT margins and strong performance in Additives and Functional Products and Chemical Intermediates. Due to tariff uncertainty, Eastman is shifting to quarterly EPS guidance, projecting $1.70 to $1.90 for Q2 2025, and has increased cost reduction targets while decreasing capital expenditures.

items.title: NOVONIX Selected for South Korea-U.S. Infrastructure Initiative
items.summary: NOVONIX Limited's Riverside synthetic graphite AAM manufacturing project has been chosen for a South Korea-U.S. government-led infrastructure initiative. This program aims to connect major U.S. projects with Korean companies, investors, and financing partners, facilitating commercial opportunities and potential strategic financial support from the Korean government. NOVONIX CEO Mike O'Kronley expressed honor at the selection, seeing it as a crucial opportunity to advance North America's battery materials manufacturing.

items.title: Genuine Parts’ 70th Straight Dividend Increase Raises New Questions About Its Capital Allocation Priorities (GPC)
items.summary: Genuine Parts Company announced its 70th consecutive annual dividend increase, raising the 2026 payout by 3.2%. This decision reinforces its commitment to shareholders and is supported by management's expectations for improved operating and free cash flow in 2026, despite recent earnings and cash flow pressures. The article questions whether this dividend increase and management's cash flow outlook can sustain profitability amidst margin pressures and cost inflation.

items.title: Smackover Lithium signs $1.5 billion agreement with LG for South West Arkansas project
items.summary: Smackover Lithium, a joint venture between Standard Lithium Ltd. and Equinor ASA, has secured a $1.5 billion agreement with LG Energy Solution to supply 8,800 metric tons of battery-quality lithium carbonate annually for 10 years from its South West Arkansas project. This deal, combined with a previous agreement with Trafigura Trading LLC, means that approximately 90% of the project's targeted offtake volume has been committed, allowing the company to proceed with project financing and a final investment decision. Commercial production is anticipated to begin in 2029, with the project aiming to support domestic battery production and reduce reliance on Chinese supply chains.

items.title: Kolibri Global Energy Stock Rises 3.33% as Oil Production Growth and Operating Leverage Lift Investor Sentiment
items.summary: Kolibri Global Energy Inc. (TSX:KEI) saw its stock rise by 3.33% due to investor optimism regarding its oil-development strategy, production potential, and leverage to supportive energy market conditions. The company's core operations are in Oklahoma, USA, focusing on horizontal drilling and modern completion techniques to enhance hydrocarbon recovery. Future performance will depend on the consistent translation of drilling capital into productive wells, higher output, attractive operating margins, and stronger free cash flow.

items.title: UBS cuts Edison International stock price target on wildfire law setback
items.summary: UBS has lowered its price target for Edison International (EIX) to $63 from $75, while maintaining a Neutral rating, following the failure of California wildfire legislation. This setback, which would have strengthened the state's liability framework, caused Edison International shares to fall 23% on August 31st. Despite the stock's decline near its 52-week low, InvestingPro analysis suggests it remains undervalued, with the company continuing to project earnings per share growth and maintaining a 6.5% dividend yield.

items.title: Why Is ISRG Investing More Aggressively in R&D Despite Macro Headwinds?
items.summary: Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) is prioritizing aggressive investment in research and development (R&D) to ensure long-term growth, despite current macroeconomic challenges and competitive pressures. This strategy focuses on innovation, including AI/ML and robotics, to expand into new disease areas like GI, cardiac, and lung interventions, rather than short-term cost-cutting. The company believes this will broaden its addressable market and strengthen its competitive moat, similar to peers like Edwards Lifesciences and Glaukos who also maintain substantial R&D spending.

items.title: Tennessee American Water Issues PFAS Settlement Credits to Customers
items.summary: Tennessee American Water has issued an $11.92 bill credit to its active customers as of August 28, 2026, bringing the total PFAS settlement proceeds distributed to over $71 per customer. This action follows the Tennessee Public Utility Commission's approval of a plan to distribute PFAS settlement funds directly to customers through bill credits. The company is also investing over $45 million in capital improvements to ensure safe water services and comply with new PFAS regulations.
